description.value: Gerick Cycle & Ski is a full-service bike and ski shop located on Nelson's main commercial strip, Baker Street, in the heart of one of BC's most celebrated mountain biking communities. The shop carries an extensive range of bikes and accessories — including Specialized, Giant, Norco, and Liv — and runs a structured service department with a dedicated mechanic team. Beyond sales and repairs, Gerick's is embedded in local riding culture through its group rides program and the 10 Spot Enduro Series.
